steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to OpenProject at http://127.0.0.1:8090/ using username admin and the password exactly as the text {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}; verify the app is signed in.
02-report: In OpenProject, inspect project Bench Project and report the subjects of all work packages whose subject starts with Seed:, exactly as shown. Do not edit anything.

03-create: In Bench Project create a work package of type Task titled exactly '{{runid}} Bench Work Package' with a description that includes the exact runid {{runid}}. Submit/create it, then verify the task exists and report its displayed #ID and description.

04-set: On the newly created work package '{{runid}} Bench Work Package' ({{03-create.work_package_id}}), set Assignee to Bench Assignee by selecting the actual autocomplete dropdown option (not just typing). Verify the saved assignee displayed on the page.
05-change: On work package '{{runid}} Bench Work Package' ({{03-create.work_package_id}}), change status to exactly 'In progress' and verify the saved status on the page.
06-set: On work package '{{runid}} Bench Work Package' ({{03-create.work_package_id}}), set the Finish date to 2026-12-31 and verify the saved date as displayed on the page.

07-add: Add a comment to work package '{{runid}} Bench Work Package' ({{03-create.work_package_id}}) whose text includes the exact runid {{runid}}. Submit it and verify the comment text appears in the work package activity.
